correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact word-set factor rank as min_B(|B|+|W|-e_W(B)): a length-two target is either itself a generator or concatenation of two length-one generators. Induced sparsity is precisely pseudoforest, and a proper nonempty tight B is equivalent to a nontrivial factorization, so one spanning cycle is precisely irreducibility. Enumerating oriented Hamilton cycles and rooted-tree cycle species yields the EGF exp(-T^2/2)/sqrt(1-2T). Independently enumerated n=1..4 distinct image sets with rank-preserving counts 1,6,72,1274 and irreducible counts 1,1,8,48; checked Stirling asymptotic. n=1 loop and n=2 opposite edge pair handled separately.
